entry.title: Stop Fragmenting Information
entry.summary: AI is not Google. Stop using it like one. Most people use AI the way they use a search engine: Have a question Ask the question Get an answer Move on to the next question Each interaction is isolated. Context resets. The human holds the full picture; AI sees only fragments. This works for simple queries. It fails for complex work. When you fragment information, AI cannot: See how this question relates to your larger goal Recognize contradictions with earlier decisions Suggest alternatives you haven't considered Catch inconsistencies across your system You become the bottleneck—manually synthesizing AI's partial answers into coherent work. You're using a collaborator as a lookup table. Instead of fragmenting, maintain a continuous information flow: Requirements → Constraints → Specification…
